{{Quote|So, friend, what are you looking for? Wait, don't tell me&mdash;I've already got your next droid right here. Why else do you think I sell Otogas?|[[Honest Blim]]|<ref name="TNEGtD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>}}
The '''Otoga line''' was a series of [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droids]] manufactured by [[Veril Line Systems/Legends|Veril Line Systems]]. The company issued dozens of subtle variations over a span of [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]], each identifiable by its own numeric code. The most widespread variety was the [[Otoga-222 maintenance droid/Legends|Otoga-222 maintenance droid]], which was produced at the height of the line's popularity.<ref name="TNEGtD" />
